verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents AI-Powered Detection in Semgrep Code for finding complex logic flaws (e.g., IDORs) and a separate 'Semgrep Assistant (AI)' that does contextual post-processing of findings to reduce noise by ~20%, both of which qualify as AI-generated insights/suggestions surfaced from scan data. However, evidence is thin — only brief doc/GitHub mentions with no detailed walkthrough of the AI Assistant's suggestion UI, remediation guidance, or independent user validation of its output quality. Missing for 10: detailed documentation/UI walkthrough of Assistant's AI suggestions, independent/community corroboration of AI insight quality, and clarity on how suggestions are surfaced to the user beyond noise reduction.
